text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion finds that her strength and status are attracting a lot of attention to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Those closest to Fine Motion, including her friend Daiwa Scarlet, worry for her, but she takes the attention in good humor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The reserved Zenno Rob Roy soon reaches out to Fine Motion as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing this, I realize that there's more to Fine Motion than her family's stature alone. She also possesses an uncanny ability to charm anyone and everyone.
